   General

·         Provides nursing services, within defined scope of practice, to patients based on patient assessment and care planning procedures

·         Performs nursing interventions such as taking vital signs, applying aseptic techniques including sterile dressing, ensuring infection control, monitoring nutritional intake and conducting specimen collection

·         Administers medication and observes and documents therapeutic effects

·         Provides pre-operative and post-operative personal and comfort care

·         Monitors patients' progress, evaluate effectiveness of nursing interventions and consults with appropriate members of healthcare team

·         Provides reproductive health/family planning education to individuals and their families.

 

 

 

 Safe Abortion Nurse Role

  • Conducts safe abortion of pregnancies upon request and/or occasioned by medical, economic, or social reasons;
  • Supplies to patients various forms of pregnancy termination procedures (pills, implants, injection, MVA procedures, drainage, etc.,) upon instructions by gynecologist;
  • Carries out emergency treatment of pregnant women to stop symptoms such as bleeding, vomiting and nausea;
  • Provides counselling on preventing unwanted pregnancies; correct use of pregnancy termination procedures;

 

  Instrument Nurse Role:

  • Prepares all surgical instruments, sets and medical supplies required for operation in accordance with accepted standards,
  • Assists doctors intra-operatively (as a Scrub Nurse, Circulating Nurse, etc.) and makes the instruments ready for other operations as required.
  • Ensures proper receipt, storage, safe keep, issuance and timely placement of orders of surgical instruments and medical supplies for theatre by pre-establishing re-order level and regular replenishment of enough stocks.

 

Operation Theatre/Scrub Nurse Role:

·         Prepares patients for surgery by washing, shaving and sterilizing the patients' operative areas, weighs, lifts, turns, and positions patients; shaves patients prior to operations;

·         Assists in surgery by laying out instruments, setting up equipment, assisting surgical teams with gowns and gloves and passing instruments to surgeons

  • Cleans and sterilizes the operating room and instruments.

·         Supervises patients' exercise routines,

·         Sets up and provide leisure activities for patients,

·         Accompanies patients on outside recreational activities and perform other duties related to patient care and comfort

·         Transports patients by wheelchair or stretcher for treatment or surgery

·         Carries messages, reports, requisitions and specimens between departments

·         Makes beds and maintains patients' rooms

 

Antenatal Care Nurse Role:

·         Takes blood pressure, temperature and pulse of pregnant women throughout their pregnancy as part of regular follow-up;

·         Carries out laboratory tests of patients as part of evaluation of health conditions of pregnant women with unusual diagnosis and reports to gynaecologist

·         Provides counselling to those pregnant women having physiological or social difficulties;

·         Observes or monitors pregnant women’s status and documents patient care on charts;

·         Administers first aid in emergency situations;

·         Administers suppositories, colonic irrigations and enemas

·         Performs other procedures as directed by supervisor

 

Related Duties/Tasks

  • Ensures the maintenance of high-level standards and applies universal precautions to prevent infection (e.g. HIV/AIDS) from blood or other body fluids of patients
  • Accounts for all assets under his/her custody during regular stock taking and audit as and when required.
  • Prepares and submits periodic reports as required.

·         Maintain inventory of supplies; accounts for all assets under his/her custody during regular stock taking and audit as and when required.

  • Prepares and submits periodic reports as required.
  • Make an on-time report for the clinical incident happened in the center as per the guideline of MSIE.
  • Performs related tasks as required

fields.title: Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affair Officer
fields.description: About Us Ethio-BioPharma Enterprise (EBPE) is Ethiopia’s state-owned pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprise, established to build the nation’s capacity to manufacture vaccines, essential medicines, diagnostics, medical supplies and other healthcare technologies locally. Operating under EIH, EBPE is developing an integrated pharmaceutical campus at the Kilinto Special Economic Zone in Addis Ababa, co-locating multiple manufacturing units that share infrastructure,talent, and corporate services. Job Summary I. GENERAL POSITION DESCRIPTION Main Purpose of the post The Quality Assurance officer will provide strategic and operational leadership and expert oversight to establish and implement a comprehensive QA system for Ethio-biopharma Enterprise’s vaccine, Pharmaceutical & diagnostics manufacturing projects. The role ensures that all phases—design, construction, commissioning, qualification, validation, technology transfer, and operational readiness comply with EFDA, WHO PQ, and international GMP standards. The officer develops robust, risk-based quality systems tailored to vaccine, diagnostics and pharmaceutical manufacturing, and works closely with engineers, architects, contractors, and regulators to ensure construction activities meet regulatory and industry requirements. Key responsibilities include quality oversight of construction, inspections, documentation review, vendor and equipment qualification, and leadership of URS, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and validation activities. The role also manages non-conformities and drives corrective and preventive actions. The officer ensures the facility is built and prepared to operate as a modern, fully compliant, state-of-the-art vaccine manufacturing plant. II. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / ACCOUNTABILITY A. Leadership Develop and implement the Quality Strategy aligned with Ethio-biopharma’s mission, regulatory expectations, and global best practices. Provide quality leadership across the enterprise and serve as the primary officer to the CEO on all quality and compliance matters. Establish and lead the Quality Management System (QMS) from the project phase through full-scale manufacturing. Ensure quality policies, governance structures, and performance indicators are well-defined and implemented. Work closely with internal staff, international consultants, EPC contractors, and regulatory bodies. Ensure GMP principles are observed in preparing architectural layouts, engineering designs, workflows, and contamination control strategies. Oversee detailed design reviews for compliance for Regulatory compliance Provide QA leadership during process design, method development, and validation planning. Plan, coordinate and monitor the Quality Assurance activities of the enterprise B. Establishment of the QA System (Project to Manufacturing Phase) Leads the establishment of a phased QMS roadmap covering: Project Phase (non-GMP but quality-governed), Pre-Operational Phase, GMP Readiness Phase, and Commercial Manufacturing Phase. Leads the design and stepwise implementation of a phase-appropriate Quality Management System (QMS) that evolves from project stage requirements to full cGMP-compliant commercial manufacturing systems. Prepares all QMS documents including document control, change management, management review, deviation handling, CAPA, supplier qualification, and risk management. Develops quality oversight mechanisms for technology transfer partners, contractors, including EPC contractors, and consultants. Establishes systems to ensure compliance during procurement of equipment, utilities, and raw materials. Ensures construction activities support smooth transition into qualification, validation, and GMP operations. C. Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness Ensures full compliance with national (EFDA) and international standards (GMP, WHO, EMA where applicable). Leads preparation for regulatory inspections, external audits, and prequalification (e.g., WHO PQ) processes. Serves as the primary point of contact with regulatory authorities on quality matters. Maintains up-to-date awareness of evolving regulations and guide the organization in implementing changes. In collaboration with the RA officer for GMP & Regulatory Affairs, supports preparation and submission of facility licensing applications and product registration dossiers. Supports EFDA, WHO PQ, and other international regulatory inspections and ensure inspection readiness. Ensure that GMP principles and QA requirements are embedded into architectural layouts, engineering designs, workflows, personnel/material flows, and contamination control strategies. Lead QA integration into planning and design activities, working closely with internal staff, international consultants, EPC contractors, regulatory bodies, and other partners. D. Validation, Qualification & Technology Transfer Oversight Oversees qualification of equipment, utilities, and cleanrooms. Participates in the preparation and QA review of User Requirement Specifications (URS) for equipment, systems, and facility components. Participates in Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT), and related inspections from a QA and compliance perspective. Provides QA oversight during equipment installation, utility commissioning, and environmental system implementation. Oversees quality considerations during facility design, construction, commissioning, and qualification (DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ). Approves validation master plans, validation protocols and ensure lifecycle validation of processes, cleaning, and analytical methods. Provides QA oversight of technology transfer activities with international partners. Ensures data integrity principles (ALCOA+, GAMP 5) are embedded in computerized systems and laboratory operations. Ensure technical transfer documents, protocols, and processes meet global GMP standards. Review and approve technology transfer plans, analytical method transfer protocols, and comparability assessments. Ensure quality, documentation, and data integrity expectations are met during transfers from technology transfer partners. Ensure readiness of facility, equipment, materials, and staff for receiving technology. Participate in and approve technology transfer quality requirements. E. Quality Governance & Documentation Establishes and maintain the Document Management System. Approves all quality-critical SOPs, policies, protocols, and reports. Develops quality governance frameworks, including Quality manual and Management Reviews. Prepares quality reports for the CEO and Board as required. F. Building & Leading the Quality Assurance Team Defines QA organizational structure and staffing plan appropriate for each project phase. Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate QA personnel to build a high-performing quality culture. Promotes a strong culture of compliance, continuous improvement, and ethical conduct across the enterprise. G. Project execution Quality Oversight Review design documents, construction drawings, specifications, and change orders for ultimate quality compliance. Ensure implementation alignment with regulatory requirements (EFDA, WHO PQ, and GMP). Provide QA oversight during material selection, equipment procurement, installation, and commissioning. Verify that critical materials (e.g., cleanroom panels, flooring, stainless steel piping, etc.) meet standards and compliant, traceable, and suitable for later qualification and validation. Work closely with consultants, engineering, contractors, procurement, and regulatory teams. Prepare and support inspections and audits during and after construction. Ensure accurate, complete, and controlled documentation for all project/construction activities. H. Training, Auditing, and Technical Leadership Provide capacity-building initiatives by training internal staff, engineers, and operational teams on QA principles, GMP standards, contamination control, validation and regulatory expectations. Lead Core Quality Assurance operations like Self inspection/Internal audit, Annual product review, Out of Specification/Out of trend activities, and the like Conduct internal QA audits, gap assessments, deviation investigations, and CAPA management to drive continuous compliance improvement. Provides QA and regulatory input on technology transfer, process design, documentation systems, and operational readiness. Conduct periodic training on GMP, data integrity, and quality systems. I. Operational Quality Oversight Oversee batch review, release procedures, and product disposition systems. Ensure Quality Risk Management (ICH Q9) is integrated into all operations. Build and oversee Good Documentation Practices (GDP) across the enterprise. Establish systems for complaints handling, product recall, and market surveillance. Ensure control of materials, supplier qualification, and vendor audits. J. Continuous Improvement Lead continuous improvement initiatives using QRM, and other appropriate quality management tools. Analyze quality metrics and trends to drive preventive actions. Implement digitalization initiatives for QMS automation and data integrity strengthening. K. Reporting and Planning Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual QA work plans and performance reports for the CEO. Report on QA system establishment progress, validation and qualification status, risk assessments, internal audit, annual product review, regulatory compliance, etc.. Provide strategic recommendations on quality risks and mitigation measures. L. Authority Authorized for technical document approval, issuance and archive Approve/reject materials & products; batch release/rejection Approve SOPs, test methods, protocols, investigations, monitoring programs, and quality related project documents Approve training programs, operator qualifications Authorized for Line clearance, contamination control, process oversight Authorized to evaluate and address contractor/vendor non-compliance and recommend corrective preventive actions Approve quality related deliverables of consultants Authorized to approve, Validation Master Plans (VMPs), validation, qualification, and vendor-qualification. Block or quarantine any material or product that does not meet specifications. Suspend production activities during deviations, contamination risks, or facility failures. Stop any operation that poses a quality, GMP, safety, or data integrity risk. Approve URS (User Requirement Specifications) for all GMP critical systems/equipment. Authorize changes through the Change Control procedure. Authorize document issuance and archival. Approve final deviation, CAPA, OOS, OOT investigations. M. Effort required Requires continuous analytical judgment, regulatory decision-making, and mental concentration. Involves periodic on-site inspections, facility walkthroughs, FAT/SAT witnessing, and construction oversight. Requires strong leadership in a multidisciplinary, fast-paced project environment. The Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affair Officer is expected to carry out other related tasks as assigned by pertinent authority Reports to: This positions reports to the CEO Salary: As per the Organization's Scale

  8. Lead QA integration into planning and design activities, working closely with internal staff, international consultants, EPC contractors, regulatory bodies, and other partners.

D. Validation, Qualification & Technology Transfer Oversight

  1. Oversees qualification of equipment, utilities, and cleanrooms.
  2. Participates in the preparation and QA review of User Requirement Specifications (URS) for equipment, systems, and facility components.
  3. Participates in Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT), and related inspections from a QA and compliance perspective.
  4. Provides QA oversight during equipment installation, utility commissioning, and environmental system implementation.
  5. Oversees quality considerations during facility design, construction, commissioning, and qualification (DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ).
  6. Approves validation master plans, validation protocols and ensure lifecycle validation of processes, cleaning, and analytical methods.
  7. Provides QA oversight of technology transfer activities with international partners.
  8. Ensures data integrity principles (ALCOA+, GAMP 5) are embedded in computerized systems and laboratory operations.
  9. Ensure technical transfer documents, protocols, and processes meet global GMP standards.
  10. Review and approve technology transfer plans, analytical method transfer protocols, and comparability assessments.
  11. Ensure quality, documentation, and data integrity expectations are met during transfers from technology transfer partners.
  12. Ensure readiness of facility, equipment, materials, and staff for receiving technology.
  13. Participate in and approve technology transfer quality requirements.

E. Quality Governance & Documentation

  1. Establishes and maintain the Document Management System.
  2. Approves all quality-critical SOPs, policies, protocols, and reports.
  3. Develops quality governance frameworks, including Quality manual and Management Reviews.
  4. Prepares quality reports for the CEO and Board as required.

F. Building & Leading the Quality Assurance Team

  1. Defines QA organizational structure and staffing plan appropriate for each project phase.
  2. Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate QA personnel to build a high-performing quality culture.
  3. Promotes a strong culture of compliance, continuous improvement, and ethical conduct across the enterprise.

G. Project execution Quality Oversight

  1. Review design documents, construction drawings, specifications, and change orders for ultimate quality compliance.
  2. Ensure implementation alignment with regulatory requirements (EFDA, WHO PQ, and GMP).
  3. Provide QA oversight during material selection, equipment procurement, installation, and commissioning.
  4. Verify that critical materials (e.g., cleanroom panels, flooring, stainless steel piping, etc.) meet standards and compliant, traceable, and suitable for later qualification and validation.
  5. Work closely with consultants, engineering, contractors, procurement, and regulatory teams.
  6. Prepare and support inspections and audits during and after construction.
  7. Ensure accurate, complete, and controlled documentation for all project/construction activities.

H. Training, Auditing, and Technical Leadership

  1. Provide capacity-building initiatives by training internal staff, engineers, and operational teams on QA principles, GMP standards, contamination control, validation and regulatory expectations.
  2. Lead Core Quality Assurance operations like Self inspection/Internal audit, Annual product review, Out of Specification/Out of trend activities, and the like
  3. Conduct internal QA audits, gap assessments, deviation investigations, and CAPA management to drive continuous compliance improvement.
  4. Provides QA and regulatory input on technology transfer, process design, documentation systems, and operational readiness.
  5. Conduct periodic training on GMP, data integrity, and quality systems.

I. Operational Quality Oversight

  1. Oversee batch review, release procedures, and product disposition systems.
  2. Ensure Quality Risk Management (ICH Q9) is integrated into all operations.
  3. Build and oversee Good Documentation Practices (GDP) across the enterprise.
  4. Establish systems for complaints handling, product recall, and market surveillance.
  5. Ensure control of materials, supplier qualification, and vendor audits.

J. Continuous Improvement

  1. Lead continuous improvement initiatives using QRM, and other appropriate quality management tools.
  2. Analyze quality metrics and trends to drive preventive actions.
  3. Implement digitalization initiatives for QMS automation and data integrity strengthening.

K. Reporting and Planning

  1. Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual QA work plans and performance reports for the CEO.
  2. Report on QA system establishment progress, validation and qualification status, risk assessments, internal audit, annual product review, regulatory compliance, etc..
  3. Provide strategic recommendations on quality risks and mitigation measures.

L. Authority

  1. Authorized for technical document approval, issuance and archive
  2. Approve/reject materials & products; batch release/rejection
  3. Approve SOPs, test methods, protocols, investigations, monitoring programs, and quality related project documents
  4. Approve training programs, operator qualifications
  5. Authorized for Line clearance, contamination control, process oversight
  6. Authorized to evaluate and address contractor/vendor non-compliance and recommend corrective preventive actions
  7. Approve quality related deliverables of consultants
  8. Authorized to approve, Validation Master Plans (VMPs), validation, qualification, and vendor-qualification.
  9. Block or quarantine any material or product that does not meet specifications.
  10. Suspend production activities during deviations, contamination risks, or facility failures.
  11. Stop any operation that poses a quality, GMP, safety, or data integrity risk.
  12. Approve URS (User Requirement Specifications) for all GMP critical systems/equipment.
  13. Authorize changes through the Change Control procedure.
  14. Authorize document issuance and archival.
  15. Approve final deviation, CAPA, OOS, OOT investigations.

M. Effort required

  1. Requires continuous analytical judgment, regulatory decision-making, and mental concentration.
  2. Involves periodic on-site inspections, facility walkthroughs, FAT/SAT witnessing, and construction oversight.
  3. Requires strong leadership in a multidisciplinary, fast-paced project environment.

The Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affair Officer is expected to carry out other related tasks as assigned by pertinent authority

Reports to: This positions reports to the CEO

Salary: As per the Organization's Scale

company.name: Repi Soap & Detergent PLC
company.description:
REPI SOAP & DETERGENT PLC formerly known as REPI Soap factory was established 1974 by the name Bianil Ethiopia Share Company by foreign investors of Swiss & Greek origin aiming to produce and distributed powdered detergent to East Africa market which was dominantly by Uniliver brand OMO. Less than a year after its formation, it was owned by the Ethiopian government & was managed under the direct supervision of the National Chemical Corporation and was re-established as a public enterprise in 1992 by the council of Ministers and was recapitalized by Birr 1,525,000.00.

 

At that time, the company main vision was  to compete  against  local & imported powder detergent through its famous brand “ROL” , due to the machinery age and technological issues there was an issue of wastage which nearly bankrupted the company but thanks to a pioneering idea of creating detergent bar (cake) in 1979, Repi gave birth to a new line of product and a new brand  “Ajax”. Again in 1994 production of a liquid detergent was introduced under the brand name ‘LARGO”

Following the earmarking of REPI Soap factory by the government for joint venture partnership , LINA PLC having registered its interest in the joint venture Commissioned Vision Consultancy PVT LTD CO to undertake a series of studies on the factory with the aim of concluding a joint venture agreement with the factory management and the E.F.D.R Privatization & Public Enterprise Supervising Authority.

 

A joint venture partnership between “LENA PLC” and E.F.D.R Privatization & Public Enterprise Supervising Authority (PESSA) was then established  during the fiscal  period 2007/2008 after intensive negotiation was carried out between both parties involved which there after paved the way for the establishment of REPI SOAP & DETERGENT SHARE COMPANY.

 

LINA PLC is a share company  mainly involved  in trading ,real estate  and small scale manufacturing of corrugated steel & tea and added REPI SOAP & DETERGENT PLC to its portfolio of investment by acquiring 51% of share amounting to Birr 9,360,000.00 of the total share amounting to 18,360 ,000 while the remaining 49% amounting to birr 9,000,000 was raised by PESSA in the form of assets based on business evaluation of the factory.

The joint venture arrangement lasted one year followed by a full takeover of the share company by

LENA PLC after settling of the remaining 49% share previously held by the Ethiopian government.

 

 In response to the growing demands of the soap & detergent, today our company is a leading player  and well respected organization in the country detergent industry. The current market demand for our product and the fact that the current factory could not provide us the product volume due to imperfect condition and age of machinery and equipment’s therefore not supplying the capacity required ,we are committed to exciting expansion project  which is in a final phase ,would be beneficial for the shareholder ,employees local businesses and overall the company. In this sector REPI has positioned itself at the fore-front of the market.

In July,2014 Repi Soap and Detergent S. Co. (Repi) and Wilmar International Limited (Wilmar) have signed a joint investment agreement for the upgrading of an existing manufacturing facility in Sebeta Road, Kolfe Karenio Sub City and building of a new integrated manufacturing complex in Dima, Sebeta Town, Oromia Region in Ethiopia that will house an edible oil refinery and packing plant, production plants for specialty fats, soft oils, soaps and detergents, as well as a facility for sesame seed processing. Repi and Wilmar will each have a 50%participation in the joint investment.

Repi is a sister company of AL-SAM Private Limited Company, incorporated and existing under the laws of the Democratic Republic of Ethiopia. It engages in the manufacturing of soap and detergent products. Headquartered in Singapore, Wilmar is Asia’s leading agribusiness group engaging in oil palm cultivation, oilseed crushing, edible oils refining, sugar milling and refining, specialty fats, oleo-chemical, biodiesel and fertilizer manufacturing, and grain processing. It has a presence in 14 countries across Africa. This joint investment marks Wilmar’s first operations in Ethiopia.

Combining the expertise of both parties, the joint investment will have a positive impact on the development of the manufacturing and export sector, as well as create employment opportunities in Ethiopia.



About Wilmar

﻿

Wilmar International Limited, founded in 1991 and headquartered in Singapore, is today Asia’s leading agribusiness group. Wilmar is ranked amongst the largest listed companies by market capitalisation on the Singapore Exchange.Wilmar’s business activities include oil palm cultivation, oilseed crushing, edible oilsrefining, sugar milling and refining, specialty fats, oleochemical, biodiesel and fertiliser manufacturing, and grain processing.

At the core of Wilmar’s strategy is a resilient integrated agribusiness model that encompasses the entire value chain of the agricultural commodity processing business, from origination and processing to branding, merchandising and distribution of a wide range of agricultural products. It has over 450 manufacturing plants and an extensive distribution network covering China, India, Indonesia and some 50 other countries. The Group is backed by a multinational workforce of about 90,000 people. Wilmar’s portfolio of high quality processed agricultural products is the preferred choice of the food manufacturing industry, as well as the industrial and consumer food businesses. Its consumer-packed products occupy a leading share in its targeted markets. Through scale, integration and the logistical advantages of its business model, Wilmar is able to extract margins at every step of the value chain, thereby reaping operational synergies and cost efficiencies.

Wilmar remains a firm advocate of sustainable growth and is committed to its role as a responsible corporate citizen.

fields.title: Sales Officer
fields.description: External Vacancy Announcement August 07, 202 International Clinical Laboratories (ICL) is one of the largest independent clinical diagnostic centers on the African continent. ICL opened its door for service in 2004 with the aim of “contributing to the maintenance and enhancement of the quality of life throughout Ethiopia” by encompassing a system of human and physical resources designed to meet the changing healthcare needs of the population it serves. It is the only laboratory accredited by the USA-based Joint Commission International (JCI) five times in a row. The laboratory provides more than 3000 tests in collaboration with its referral laboratories. ICL would like to fill the following vacant positions under the Business Development Department by inviting all qualified and competent applicants: Job Summary: The Sales Representative Officer will be base in Head Office, Addis Ababa Bulgaria Branch regions and will primary be responsible for driving revenue growth by generating new business opportunities, acquiring new clients, and actively promoting the laboratory’s services. This includes generating new business ideas, developing and executing sales strategies, identifying and pursuing new clients, conducting sales presentations, participating in promotional activities, and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets. Major Duties and Responsibilities Develop and implement sales strategies and business development plans that align with the laboratory's growth objectives. Keeping abreast of new services, projects, developments, and approaches of the company. Identify and pursue sales opportunities within the healthcare industry. This includes researching potential clients, attending industry events, making cold calls, and conducting sales presentations to promote laboratory services and solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, including healthcare providers, hospitals, clinics, and other stakeholders. Also serve as the primary point of contact for key clients, addressing their needs, answering inquiries, and providing exceptional customer services. Achieve individual and team sales targets. This includes meeting or exceeding revenue goals, tracking sales metrics, and providing regular reports on sales performance. Address complaints from clients by working closely with Client Relation section and relevant departments. Providing inputs on preparation of promotional materials in addition to distributing them Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as laboratory managers, clinicians, and other departments to ensure effective communication and coordination regarding sales activities. This includes collaborating sales campaigns, gathering client feedback, sharing market intelligence, and coordinating with the client relations team to ensure seamless client onboarding. Stay up to date with industry trends in the clinical laboratory industry. This includes staying updated on new technologies, competitor activities, and industry regulations to effectively position the laboratory's services and maintain a competitive edge. Work with the Client relation and Customer service departments to assist with situating new & existing clients & and their staffs into the company’s system and maintain smooth communication. Drive a high-performance team culture. Take ownership of new opportunities, managing the sales funnel efficiently to achieve swift and successful deal closures.

About the company

Teklehaimanot General Hospital is a patient-centered private hospital in the center of Addis Ababa that provides trusted multi-disciplinary medical services. With a focus on quality and customer care, it has a distinctive, compassionate, and honest approach to serving the need of all patients. Devised with experienced and compassionate medical staff, TGH is a health coach and medical partner to cater to all medical care needs. “An earnest deed is worth more than silver and gold” so fairness in price, quality, and flexibility creates a shelter for hope and recovery.
Through decades of unwavering endeavor to be a patient-centered private hospital, TGH is proud to offer over 70 General, specialty, subspecialty, and supportive services with 402 dedicated staff, of which 329 are full-time employees and 73 are part-time and contractual employees equipped with a culture of medical teamwork. Its credit program serves over 100 companies, Local and international companies, sharing in the grandeur of full hospitality that builds lasting patient-to-care provider relationships. For seven consecutive years, TGH has been ranked “Green Level” general hospital.

Our Mission

  • To be among the premium and most preferred healthcare providers in East Africa

Our Vision

  • To provide quality health care services at a reasonable price 

Our Values

“To nurture all human beings principled in honesty through compassion with the utmost respect”
TGH, with a strong commitment to nurturing all human beings, upholds the principles of honesty, compassion, and utmost respect. Through its unwavering dedication to providing exceptional healthcare services, The Hospital strives to become a trusted institution, a place where patients find solace, comfort, and the promise of a brighter future.
At Teklehaimanot General Hospital the core value of “nurturing all human beings’’ resonates throughout every aspect of the organization. From the moment patients step through the doors, they are greeted with warmth and empathy. The hospital's dedicated team of healthcare and Customer service professionals understands the critical importance of treating patients not just as medical cases, but as individuals deserving of kindness, compassion, and personalized attention. Every patient is regarded as a unique story, and the hospital's mission is to provide holistic care that addresses both physical and emotional well-being.
“Honesty” is the bedrock upon which Teklehaimanot General Hospital stands. Transparent communication, ethical practices, and integrity are the guiding principles that shape every interaction within the hospital. Patients and their families can trust that they will receive accurate information about their conditions, treatment options, and the overall care process. The hospital's commitment to honesty ensures that patients are empowered to make informed decisions and actively participate in their healthcare journey.
“Compassion” is the lifeblood that flows through the veins of Teklehaimanot General Hospital. The hospital's healthcare professionals are not only highly skilled and knowledgeable but also deeply empathetic and understanding. They recognize that patients may be experiencing fear, pain, or uncertainty and go above and beyond to provide comfort and support. Whether it's holding a hand, offering a listening ear, or providing words of encouragement, the hospital's staff is devoted to fostering an environment that promotes healing and emotional well-being.
Above all, Teklehaimanot General Hospital treats every individual with “utmost respect”. Regardless of age, gender, socioeconomic status, or background, every patient is valued and treated with dignity. The hospital's commitment to respect extends to its commitment to cultural sensitivity and inclusivity. The diverse needs and beliefs of patients are honored, and efforts are made to create an environment that is welcoming and accommodating to all.

Why work for us

Choosing to work for Teklehaimanot General Hospital means joining a healthcare institution that values its employees, patients, and the community at large. We provide an environment that fosters professional growth, collaboration, and innovation, while emphasizing the importance of delivering exceptional patient care. With our commitment to excellence, cutting-edge facilities, and a supportive work culture, Teklehaimanot General Hospital offers a fulfilling and rewarding career path for healthcare professionals seeking to make a difference.  The following facts highlight the numerous benefits and opportunities that await prospective candidates who choose TGH.
1. Commitment to Patient Care:
At Teklehaimanot General Hospital, our primary focus is on delivering high-quality patient care. Our employees are driven by a shared mission to make a positive impact on the lives of individuals and their families. By working with us, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the well-being of the community and play a crucial role in saving lives and improving health outcomes.
2. Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment:
We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages teamwork, communication, and professional growth. Our hospital values the contributions of each employee and believes in a culture of respect, inclusivity, and continuous learning. You will have the chance to work alongside skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds, creating a stimulating and enriching atmosphere that allows for personal and career development.
3. Opportunities for Professional Development:
We believe in investing in our employees' growth and development. Teklehaimanot General Hospital offers a range of opportunities for professional advancement, including ongoing training programs, workshops, conferences, and mentorship initiatives. We encourage our employees to expand their knowledge and skills, fostering a culture of continuous professional development that supports career progression within the organization.
4. Competitive Compensation and Benefits:
We understand the importance of recognizing and rewarding our employees' hard work and dedication. Teklehaimanot General Hospital offers competitive compensation packages that are commensurate with industry standards, ensuring that employees feel valued and motivated. Additionally, we strictly adhere to privilege package that are stated on Ethiopian labor law.
5. Ethical and Transparent Practices:
As an organization, we prioritize ethical conduct and maintain transparency in our operations. Teklehaimanot General Hospital upholds the highest standards of integrity, ensuring that our employees work in an environment built on trust, honesty, and accountability. We are committed to maintaining a positive reputation and upholding the trust placed in us by our patients and the community.

Team Benefits

Teklehaimanot General Hospital has implemented a comprehensive range of employee benefits aimed at promoting employee well-being and job satisfaction. This write-up will explore the various employer benefits offered by Teklehaimanot General Hospital:
  • Partial medical coverage (including family)
  • Attractive Remuneration
  • Allowances (transportation, representation, and others)
  • Service charge
  • Successive training programs that are tailored to enrich professional, leadership and self-development skills of candidates.

raw_payload.title: Call Operator, Casher Front Desk Officer
raw_payload.description:
Call Operator, Casher, Front Desk Officer at Teklehaimanot General Hospital plays a vital role in ensuring an exceptional experience for patients and visitors. This full-time, entry-level position is ideal for fresh graduates seeking to launch their careers in customer service. The officer will work in an office environment, assisting with inquiries, resolving issues, and providing comprehensive support to enhance patient satisfaction and hospital reputation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist patients and visitors with inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.
  • Handle incoming calls and respond to emails promptly and effectively.
  • Coordinate with various departments to resolve patient issues and concerns.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and transactions.
  • Provide information about hospital services, policies, and procedures.
  • Monitor and manage waiting times to improve patient experience.
  • Gather feedback from patients to identify areas for improvement.
  • Support administrative tasks as needed to facilitate hospital operations.
  • Attend training sessions to enhance customer service skills and knowledge.
  • Contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment.

Report daily performance in their respective shifts

§  Confirm availability of raw materials and packaging materials before start-up.

§  Monitor equipment performance and promptly report faults, stoppages, or abnormalities.

§  Ensure accurate and complete recording of daily production data (output, downtime, waste, etc.).

§  Support efficient line changeovers and cleaning between product types.

§  Quality and Food Safety

§  Ensure all production processes comply with company quality standards, GMP, HACCP, and ISO requirements.

§  Coordinate closely with Quality Control to verify critical product parameters (temperature, weight, coding accuracy, etc.).

§  Stop production immediately and report whenever non-conforming product is detected.

§  Ensure that all employees adhere to hygiene guidelines and properly use PPE.

§  Support line sanitation, cleaning, and pre-operational checks.

§  Team Supervision

§  Lead and coordinate operators, processors, and helpers assigned to the line.

§  Assign daily tasks and ensure all team members understand their responsibilities.

§  Coach and guide new employees on safety, hygiene, and work procedures.

§  Report attendance issues, discipline cases, and manpower shortages to the Shift Leader.

§  Safety and Workplace Hygiene

§  Ensure all employees wear appropriate PPE and follow safety procedures.

§  Identify, correct, and report unsafe acts, near misses, and equipment hazards.

§  Maintain a clean, organized, and obstruction-free working environment.

fields.title: Refugee Education Transition Advisor
fields.description: GIZ- Internal/External Vacancy Announcement Project office- The Global Programme Refugee Inclusion Accelerator (RISE) Contract duration-31.03.2028 Note: Please note that the position title will be changed to Advisor during the recruitment process Brief Description of the Project The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH has been working in Ethiopia for more than 50 years on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and other international partners. GIZ supports the Government of Ethiopia in strengthening public institutions and promoting inclusive and sustainable development. The Global Programme Refugee Inclusion Accelerator (RISE) and the planned Joint Project with the UNHCR “ Supporting the Inclusion of Displaced Persons and Host Communities in Ethiopia ” are commissioned under BMZ's Special Initiative on Displaced Persons and Host Countries. Both projects support the Government of Ethiopia in implementing the Makatet Roadmap and advancing the inclusion of refugees into national systems. As part of this commitment, the Government of Ethiopia is leading the gradual transition of refugee schools from humanitarian management into the national education system. This is a complex reform process requiring strengthened institutional capacities, effective coordination among national, regional and international stakeholders, and the development of sustainable systems and approaches to support implementation. The Government is supported in this process through substantial financial support from the World Bank. This position will initially be established under RISE and, subject to commissioning, is intended to transition to the Joint Project with UNHCR to ensure continuity of technical support throughout the education transition process. The Advisor provides technical advisory services to the Ministry of Education while leading the implementation of GIZ's technical support for the education transition, with a particular focus on national coordination and implementation in Benishangul-Gumuz Regional State (BGRS). Main Activities: The Advisor provides technical advisory services to the Ministry of Education and other relevant government institutions and leads the design, coordination and implementation of GIZ's technical assistance for the education transition. The Advisor is responsible for the following tasks: Provide strategic technical advisory to the Ministry of Education, the BGRS-Bureau of Education, the Refugees and Returnees Service (RRS) and other relevant government partners on the implementation of the refugee education transition in line with the Makatet Roadmap, including the strengthening of institutional coordination, governance and implementation arrangements. Support government-led systems development by facilitating the development of institutional frameworks, policy recommendations, operational guidelines and practical tools for integrating refugee education into national planning, budgeting, monitoring, quality assurance and other government systems. Coordinate technical assistance provided through the project, including national and international consultants, and ensure the quality and timely delivery of technical studies, assessments, technical concepts, policy recommendations and other knowledge products supporting government decision-making. Lead institutional readiness assessments and capacity development in BGRS by coordinating school, woreda and institutional assessments, analysing findings together with government partners, and designing and supporting the implementation of capacity development measures, including training programmes, technical workshops, coaching, peer learning and on-the-job advisory support. Lead the development of sustainable qualification pathways for refugee incentive teachers together with the Ministry of Education, teacher education institutions and relevant accreditation authorities, including accredited upgrading programmes, Recognition of Prior Learning approaches and other mechanisms supporting future integration into Ethiopia's public education system. Facilitate coordination and partnership among relevant government institutions, development partners and humanitarian actors by supporting technical working groups and other coordination mechanisms under the Makatet Roadmap and ensuring effective collaboration throughout the education transition process. Ensure quality, learning and cross-cutting integration by mainstreaming gender equality, protection and social cohesion across all technical interventions, documenting lessons learned and good practices, and preparing technical concepts, policy papers, implementation guidelines, briefing notes and reports. Duty travel to BGRS and other refugee hosting areas required

company.name: Transsion Manufacturing PLC
company.description:
TRANSSION MANUFACTURING PLC.

Background

Transsion Holdings is a manufacturer of mobile phones based in Shenzhen, China. It was the largest smartphone manufacturer by sales in Africa in 2017, and also sells mobile phones in South Asia. Its brands include phone brands, Itel and Infinix after-sales service brand Carlcare and accessories brand Oraimo. It manufactures phones in China, Pakistan, Ethiopia, and Bangladesh and recently at India.

Transsion Holdings Pvt. Ltd was founded as Transsion Technology in Hong Kong in 2006, with a focus on the development, manufacturing, sales, and services of mobile communication products. Transsion entered the African market with its Tecno and Itel brands, and started focusing on the African market in July 2008, initially with feature phones Transsion released its first smartphone in 2014.Transsion set up its Nigerian subsidiary in June 2008, and had subsidiaries in seven countries in Africa by October that year. Transsion set up a manufacturing plant in Ethiopia in 2011. Transsion entered the Indian market in 2016. The market share of Transsion's smartphone brands in Africa combined surpassed that of Samsung in 2017, making Transsion the largest manufacturer of smartphones for the African market in the fourth quarter of 2017.Transsion was also the largest manufacturer of mobile phones in Africa in the first half of 2017.Transsion's 2018 attempt at a reverse takeover failed. In October 2018, Transsion Holdings started producing smartphones in their new manufacturing plant in Bangladesh.Transsion Holdings became a public listed company in September 2019 by listing on the STAR Market section of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

Operations

Transsion sells mobile phones in Africa and South Asia. It operates mobile phone brands Tecno, Itel, and Infinix, as well as after-sales support service Carlcare and accessories brand Oraimo. Spice Digital, an Indian phone brand, was acquired in 2017. Transsion manufactures its phones in China, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan. Transsion was the first non-African mobile phone company to set up an after-sales support network in Africa.Transsion's success in the African market has been attributed to tailoring its phones' features to the needs of the African market. Transsion's phones offer a featurethat calibrates camera exposures for darker skin tones, allowing face details to be retained. Transsion developed phones with dual SIM functionality, which were well received because African users commonly used more than one SIM card at a time save money. Transsion released phones with long battery life, which are suited to low electrification rates in Africa and the propensity of blackouts. The phones included support for multiple African languages, and Tecno was the first major mobile phone brand in Ethiopia to include support for an Amharic keyboard. Transsion heavily advertises its mobile phone brands in Africa.

Vision

To become the most popular provider of smart devices and mobile services for

consumers in global emerging markets

Mission

To improve the lives of as many people as possible through technology and

innovation

CORE VALUES

·      Customer

Customers are both the starting point and the end point for all work of TRANSSIONers

·      Respect

Respect defines how we treat each other and our differences.

·      Openness

Staying open connects us to the future and its possibilities.

·      Innovation

Innovation is essential to achieving breakthroughs on different levels, both

personal and organizational.

·      Sharing

Sharing invites every “I” to become “we”.

·      Bottom line

We always show compassion, even if it puts us at a disadvantage.

It manufactures phones in China, Pakistan, Ethiopia, and Bangladesh and recently at India.

Transsion Holdings Pvt. Ltd was founded as Transsion Technology in Hong Kong in 2006, with a focus on the development, manufacturing, sales, and services of mobile communication products. Transsion entered the African market with its Tecno and Itel brands, and started focusing on the African market in July 2008, initially with feature phones Transsion released its first smartphone in 2014.Transsion set up its Nigerian subsidiary in June 2008, and had subsidiaries in seven countries in Africa by October that year. Transsion set up a manufacturing plant in Ethiopia in 2011. Transsion entered the Indian market in 2016. The market share of Transsion's smartphone brands in Africa combined surpassed that of Samsung in 2017, making Transsion the largest manufacturer of smartphones for the African market in the fourth quarter of 2017.Transsion was also the largest manufacturer of mobile phones in Africa in the first half of 2017.Transsion's 2018 attempt at a reverse takeover failed. In October 2018, Transsion Holdings started producing smartphones in their new manufacturing plant in Bangladesh.Transsion Holdings became a public listed company in September 2019 by listing on the STAR Market section of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

Operations

Transsion sells mobile phones in Africa and South Asia. It operates mobile phone brands Tecno, Itel, and Infinix, as well as after-sales support service Carlcare and accessories brand Oraimo. Spice Digital, an Indian phone brand, was acquired in 2017. Transsion manufactures its phones in China, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan. Transsion was the first non-African mobile phone company to set up an after-sales support network in Africa.Transsion's success in the African market has been attributed to tailoring its phones' features to the needs of the African market. Transsion's phones offer a featurethat calibrates camera exposures for darker skin tones, allowing face details to be retained. Transsion developed phones with dual SIM functionality, which were well received because African users commonly used more than one SIM card at a time save money. Transsion released phones with long battery life, which are suited to low electrification rates in Africa and the propensity of blackouts. The phones included support for multiple African languages, and Tecno was the first major mobile phone brand in Ethiopia to include support for an Amharic keyboard. Transsion heavily advertises its mobile phone brands in Africa.

Vision

To become the most popular provider of smart devices and mobile services for

consumers in global emerging markets

Mission

To improve the lives of as many people as possible through technology and

innovation

CORE VALUES

·      Customer

Customers are both the starting point and the end point for all work of TRANSSIONers

·      Respect

Respect defines how we treat each other and our differences.

·      Openness

Staying open connects us to the future and its possibilities.

·      Innovation

Innovation is essential to achieving breakthroughs on different levels, both

personal and organizational.

·      Sharing

Sharing invites every “I” to become “we”.

·      Bottom line

We always show compassion, even if it puts us at a disadvantage.

company.name: Ahadu Bank S.C
company.description:
Why work for us?


By joining us, you'll help empower Ethiopians through our pioneering cutting-edge financial services. Join our passionate team, driven by purpose, integrity, and a desire to make a real difference. We offer a dynamic environment, opportunities for growth, and the chance to be part of something revolutionary. Embrace your purpose and build a fulfilling career. This is your chance to shape the future of Ethiopian finance.


Employee Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Medical Coverage
  • Salary Advance Loan
  • Consumer Loan
  • Mortgage and Vehicle Acquisition Loan.



The Company

Established by visionary entrepreneurs and professionals, Ahadu Bank provides a different model of banking centered on the philosophy of Inclusive Intermediation.

Founded by over 10,000 shareholders and incorporated under the Ethiopian Banking Business Proclamation, Ahadu Bank offers full-fledged commercial banking services. The Bank is domiciled in Ethiopia with its Head Office located on Africa Avenue, Sunshine Building, Addis Ababa.

Ahadu Bank completed the National Bank of Ethiopia's (NBE) initial capital requirement on January 2, 2021, and received its banking license on October 5, 2021. On June 29, 2022, the bank received authorization from the NBE to begin operations and officially opened its doors on July 16, 2022.

According to a June 2024 report, the bank now boasts over 100 branches and a workforce exceeding 900 employees nationwide.


Mission

Pioneer avant-garde financial services for promoting the economic welfare of Ethiopians.


Vision

Take a lead role in the financial sector, in 2025 E.C, in support of the aspirations of the citizenry and the country.


Core values

  1. Fear of God
  2. Passion for Serving
  3. Honesty
  4. Organizational Learning
  5. Proactive Accountability
  6. Humaneness


Our way

We strive to drive the development of Ethiopia's financial services to benefit Ethiopians in a sustainable and inclusive way. We strive to have a positive socio-economic impact in every aspect of our business. We believe that addressing the needs of the unbanked and underbanked by reaching out to rural communities, supporting and nurturing small businesses, practicing responsible banking principles, and investing in innovative technology to digitize our operations helps us create value for our customers, shareholders, and the broader community.


Culture

At Ahadu Bank, our culture thrives on a unique blend of purpose and progress. We're driven by a deep desire to make a positive impact, evident in our core values of social responsibility and financial empowerment for all Ethiopians. We're a passionate team, working together to pioneer cutting-edge financial solutions. Our commitment to innovation goes hand-in-hand with integrity, ensuring we operate with honesty and ethical practices. We believe in fostering a growth mindset, embracing "Organizational Learning" to continuously develop ourselves and each other. This collaborative spirit is core to our success, as we build a supportive and dynamic environment where everyone can thrive. If you're looking to make a real difference and be part of something revolutionary, Ahadu Bank is the place for you.

company.name: Amhara Bank S.C.
company.description:
The bank was established with the largest initial shareholder base in the history of Ethiopia's private banking sector, comprising over 167,000 shareholders. The bank's paid-up capital has reached more than 7.4 billion ETB. As of recent financial reporting, its total capital reserves exceed 10.285 billion Birr.


Operations and Services

Amhara Bank operates a network of over 322 branches across Ethiopia, serving a customer base of approximately 2.9 million individuals.


Digital Banking

The bank provides digital financial services, primarily through a proprietary mobile banking application. The digital platform has registered over 1.2 million subscribers.


Interest-Free Banking

Amhara Bank operates a full-fledged interest-free banking (IFB) window under the brand name "Marhaba," which was launched on March 18, 2023. The service offers Sharia-compliant financial products tailored for customers seeking non-interest financial solutions.

fields.title: Digital Marketing Officer
fields.description: Company: RE/MAX Ethiopia Department: Marketing Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia Employment Type: Full-Time About RE/MAX Ethiopia RE/MAX Ethiopia is the Ethiopian franchise of RE/MAX®, one of the world’s largest and most recognized real estate franchise organizations. As part of the global RE/MAX network, we connect property owners, developers, investors, buyers, tenants, and members of the Ethiopian diaspora with international best practices in real estate sales, marketing, consulting, and investment advisory. We are committed to raising the standard of real estate in Ethiopia through professional, transparent, technology-driven, and client-focused services. About the Role We are looking for a Digital Marketing Officer to establish and grow RE/MAX Ethiopia’s digital presence, build engaged online communities, generate qualified leads, and support property sales through creative and effective digital marketing. The ideal candidate will be hands-on and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of our digital platforms, develop engaging content, manage social media channels, and execute digital advertising campaigns that strengthen our brand and generate measurable business results. Key Responsibilities Establish, develop, and manage RE/MAX Ethiopia’s social media platforms and digital presence. Develop and execute a practical social media and digital marketing strategy aligned with the company’s brand and business objectives. Create, curate, and publish engaging content across relevant digital platforms, including writing captions, copy, and calls to action. Develop content calendars and ensure consistent, timely, and high-quality content publishing. Support the creation of property-focused content that effectively showcases listings and attracts potential buyers, sellers, tenants, and investors. Manage digital advertising campaigns, including audience targeting, campaign setup, monitoring, optimization, and performance tracking. Monitor social media channels, respond to inquiries and comments, and ensure potential customer leads are promptly followed up and transferred to the Sales Team. Work closely with the Content Creator, Designer, Marketing Manager, and Sales Team to develop effective campaigns and property marketing materials. Monitor digital marketing trends, audience behavior, competitor activity, and relevant real estate content to identify new opportunities. Track and report on social media, advertising, audience engagement, lead generation, and website performance. Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements to content, targeting, and digital marketing activities. Ensure digital leads and customer information are accurately recorded and coordinated with the relevant team. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is creative, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable taking ownership . You should be able to build digital marketing activities from the ground up, create content that people want to engage with, and understand how social media and digital advertising can contribute directly to business growth. You should also be comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment and collaborating closely with sales and marketing teams. Key Competencies Social Media & Digital Marketing: Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing, and online audience growth. Content Creation: Ability to create engaging content, write strong captions and copy, and communicate effectively through digital channels. Digital Advertising: Practical understanding of paid social media advertising, audience targeting, and campaign optimization. Analytics & Results Orientation: Ability to track performance, interpret digital marketing data, and use insights to improve results. Creativity & Initiative: A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to develop ideas and take ownership of building the company’s digital presence.

company.name: Marie Stopes International Ethiopia
company.description:
About the company

Marie Stopes International (MSI) is one of the largest international Sexual Reproductive Health (SRH) and Family Planning (FP) organizations in the world. We are a results oriented social enterprise that develop efficient, effective and sustainable SRH/FP programmes around the world.

Marie Stopes International Ethiopia (MSIE), a partner of MSI, is currently undertaking a dramatic scale-up of health service delivery for low income women and couples in Ethiopia. This includes expanding services in clinics and rural outreach programs into new regions of Ethiopia and creating social franchising networks of private quality service providers.  MSIE announces information about job vacancies widely and encourages applications from all sectors of the community.  MSIE considers all applicants based on their abilities and will ensure no group is disadvantaged on the basis of disability, gender, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race (which includes colour, nationality and ethnic or national origins), religion or belief, economic or social class, sex, HIV/AIDs status and political affiliation.

MSIE also implements a Safeguarding Policy to safeguard and protect the rights of staff, children, young people and vulnerable sections of the community and to this end, successful candidates will need to sign MSIE’s ‘code of conduct’ and undergo a background check. The Safeguarding Policy includes an adult Safeguarding, dignity at work place, child safeguarding, human trafficking and anti-slavery, sexual harassment, equality and diversity.  MSIE applies zero tolerance approach for the violation such policies. 

MSIE is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to hiring and retaining female employees. The organization has flexible policies including: travel policy for pregnant and lactating women, flexible work hour for non-clinic staff without reducing the total working hour. Women employees have access to on-job mentorship which aim to create gender-sensitive and inclusive work environment. As such, qualified women are encouraged to apply 

 

Our Mission

Ensuring the Individual’s Right to Children by Choice not Chance.

Vision
To become a sustainable nationwide provider of high quality, integrated reproductive health/family planning services.

Our Values

1 Mission driven
With unwavering commitment, we exist to empower women and men to have children by choice not chance.

2 Client centred
We are dedicated to our clients and work tirelessly to deliver high-quality, high-impact services that meet their individual needs.

3 Accountable
We are accountable for our actions and focus on results, ensuring long term sustainability and increasing the impact of the Partnership.

4 Courageous
We recruit and nurture talented, passionate and brave people who have the courage to push boundaries, make tough decisions and challenge others in line with our mission.
 

Why work for us

MSI works in 37 countries around the world to help women and girls to have children by choice, not chance.

For an individual woman or girl, being able to choose when she has children means having the power to take control of her future.
It can mean having the ability to finish her education, pursue a career, look after the children she already has and ensure she remains healthy. MSI was founded in 1976 to provide the contraception and safe abortion services that give women and girls a choice. Since then, choice has been at the heart of everything that we do and our mission remains clear: to help women and girls to have children by choice, not chance.

MSI is a global organisation with 11,000 team members working in 37 countries to deliver our mission. Starting from one single clinic in London, our organisation has grown from one clinic in central London to become one of the world’s largest providers of high quality, affordable contraception and safe abortion services.
Over the last 40 years, we have touched the lives of more than 120 million women and girls, giving them the power to take control of their futures. But we know that there is much more to do, today there are over 230 million women who want to use contraception but can't and that number continues to grow.

fields.title: Health System Advisor
fields.description: Ipas is a non-profit organization working to improve women’s lives by focusing on improving access to information and services to basic sexual and reproductive health across the globe. Since the year 2000, Ipas Ethiopia has been collaborating with the Ministry of Health (MOH), Regional Health Bureaus (RHBs), Community Based Organizations (CBOs) and various local and international partners to reduce maternal mortality and morbidity resulting from unwanted pregnancy and unsafe abortion. In light of the need to strengthen our relationship with stakeholders and expedite program implementation, we are planning to hire for the following position: Job Title: Health System Advisor No. of vacant Positions: 3 Place of Work: 1 for Amhara Region: South and North Wollo zones 1 for Central Ethiopia: Alaba, Kembata and Hadiya zones 1 for Oromia Region: East & West Hararge zones Report to : Regional Program Leads Position Type: Full-time Grade : S1 Terms of Employment: One year with possibilities for extension. Salary : Negotiable General Description: The Health System Advisor will serve as Ipas’s focal person in the specified zones of Oromia / Central Ethiopia / Amhara regions. Based in the premises of the regional health bureaus, the incumbents will coordinate Ipas’s work in the region by closely working with partner organizations to expedite project implementation. S/he is expected to work closely with the staff of the regional health bureau and create a positive working environment in discharging her/his responsibilities. Duties and Responsibilities: Plan, coordinate and implement Training and Service Delivery Improvement (TSDI) activities in the specified zones of Oromia / Central Ethiopia / Amhara regions. Identify training and service delivery improvement needs and ensure conduct of training for service delivery improvement in comprehensive abortion care (CAC), Comprehensive Contraceptive (CC) and post abortion Family Planning (PAFP) in supported facilities. Provide technical and program support to the Oromia / Central Ethiopia / Amhara regional health bureaus and supported facilities in providing access to quality CAC, CC and PAFP services. Initiate and implement sustainable quality improvement measures in facilities providing CAC, CC and PAFP services. In collaboration with relevant other personnel, ensure that medical equipment, drugs, commodities and necessary supplies are provided/available at supported health facilities. Based on experiences from the field, suggest innovative ways of improving TSDI interventions for CAC, CC and PAFP services. Closely follow up and support regional training centers as part of the effort to building regional self-sufficiency in training health providers. Work with health professional training institutions to assist integration of comprehensive abortion care and long term contraceptive methods in their trainings. Support community level work on CAC, CC and PAFP including health extension program and its linkage to supported facilities and access to services. Provide joint monitoring and supportive supervision to the health system, supported facilities and ensure provision of high quality CAC, CC and PAFP services and increased utilization of services. Maintain database of trained providers and ensure follow-up and support system. Collect, analyze/review and share quarterly service statistics. Submit progress reports to country office and regional health bureau. Document and disseminate regional best practices and lessons learnt. Undertake other related assignments as needed. Note : Female applicants are highly encouraged to apply. Ipas management reserves the right to modify the contents of this position description at any time. Ipas is strongly committed to providing a work environment that is free from all forms of harassment, discrimination, and inequity. We recruit, employ, train, promote, and compensate our personnel without regard to race, age, sex, religion, national origin, color,creed, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, military service, disability, genetic information, or any other personal characteristics protected by law or outlined by Ipas policy.

Place of Work:

  • 1 for Amhara Region: South and North Wollo zones
  • 1 for Central Ethiopia: Alaba, Kembata and Hadiya zones
  • 1 for Oromia Region: East & West Hararge zones

Report to: Regional Program Leads

Position Type: Full-time

Grade: S1

Terms of Employment: One year with possibilities for extension.

Salary: Negotiable

General Description: The Health System Advisor will serve as Ipas’s focal person in the specified zones of Oromia / Central Ethiopia / Amhara regions. Based in the premises of the regional health bureaus, the incumbents will coordinate Ipas’s work in the region by closely working with partner organizations to expedite project implementation. S/he is expected to work closely with the staff of the regional health bureau and create a positive working environment in discharging her/his responsibilities.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, coordinate and implement Training and Service Delivery Improvement (TSDI) activities in the specified zones of Oromia / Central Ethiopia / Amhara regions.
  • Identify training and service delivery improvement needs and ensure conduct of training for service delivery improvement in comprehensive abortion care (CAC), Comprehensive Contraceptive (CC) and post abortion Family Planning (PAFP) in supported facilities.
  • Provide technical and program support to the Oromia / Central Ethiopia / Amhara regional health bureaus and supported facilities in providing access to quality CAC, CC and PAFP services.
  • Initiate and implement sustainable quality improvement measures in facilities providing CAC, CC and PAFP services.
  • In collaboration with relevant other personnel, ensure that medical equipment, drugs, commodities and necessary supplies are provided/available at supported health facilities.
  • Based on experiences from the field, suggest innovative ways of improving TSDI interventions for CAC, CC and PAFP services.
  • Closely follow up and support regional training centers as part of the effort to building regional self-sufficiency in training health providers.
  • Work with health professional training institutions to assist integration of comprehensive abortion care and long term contraceptive methods in their trainings.
  • Support community level work on CAC, CC and PAFP including health extension program and its linkage to supported facilities and access to services.
  • Provide joint monitoring and supportive supervision to the health system, supported facilities and ensure provision of high quality CAC, CC and PAFP services and increased utilization of services.
  • Maintain database of trained providers and ensure follow-up and support system.
  • Collect, analyze/review and share quarterly service statistics.
  • Submit progress reports to country office and regional health bureau.
  • Document and disseminate regional best practices and lessons learnt.
  • Undertake other related assignments as needed.

Note:

  • Female applicants are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Ipas management reserves the right to modify the contents of this position description at any time.
  • Ipas is strongly committed to providing a work environment that is free from all forms of harassment, discrimination, and inequity. We recruit, employ, train, promote, and compensate our personnel without regard to race, age, sex, religion, national origin, color,creed, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, military service, disability, genetic information, or any other personal characteristics protected by law or outlined by Ipas policy.

fields.title: Deputy Project Director / Chief of Party
fields.description: About Opian Opian is an Ethiopian health-technology and innovation company building decision infrastructure for stronger health systems. We combine deep knowledge of how care and supply chains operate, human-centred product design, data engineering and responsible artificial intelligence. Our work helps health workers, managers and public institutions turn fragmented data into timely decisions—so essential medicines, vaccines and services are available where and when people need them. Our philosophy We believe useful innovation is not novelty for its own sake. It is the disciplined work of understanding a real problem, challenging assumptions, building and testing a better response, measuring what changes, and strengthening the institutions that must sustain the result. Technology is valuable only when it improves a decision, a workflow or an outcome in the real operating environment. · Start with reality: design around the health workers, workloads, incentives, infrastructure and constraints that actually exist—not an imported ideal workflow. · Build with people, not for them: government counterparts and frontline users are co-designers, decision-makers and eventual owners, not passive recipients. · Strengthen the system, not a standalone application: connect workflows, data, institutions and incentives so information can lead to action across every level. · Push boundaries responsibly: make ambitious but testable bets, protect safety and privacy, and change direction quickly when evidence contradicts the original idea. · Make capability local and durable: transfer knowledge, product ownership and operational responsibility so progress continues without permanent dependence on an external project team. · Be honest about impact: distinguish deployment from adoption and activity from results; make claims specific, measurable and open to verification. What this means for candidates Opian is looking for accomplished specialists who are also builders. Candidates should bring exceptional depth in their discipline, intellectual courage, practical judgment and the humility to learn from users and evidence. We value people who can move from ambiguity to a testable approach, from a workshop to an operating routine, and from a promising pilot to an institutionally owned system. The standard is simple: show not only what you know, but what you personally built, changed, tested, learned and left stronger. · Work across public health, supply chain, policy, product, technology and field implementation boundaries. · Turn expertise into usable products, processes, decisions and measurable improvements—not reports alone. · Operate with urgency while preserving quality, public trust, data protection, service continuity and government ownership. Role purpose Translate the program strategy into disciplined day-to-day execution. The Deputy Project Director will run the integrated delivery system, coordinate technical and field teams, manage dependencies, maintain delivery standards and act for the Project Director when delegated. Key responsibilities · Maintain the integrated master workplan, milestone schedule, dependency map, decision log, risk register and action tracker. · Coordinate product, supply-chain, interoperability, implementation, government-partnership, finance and evaluation teams around a single delivery cadence. · Chair weekly delivery reviews and ensure that unresolved constraints are escalated with clear options and accountable owners. · Oversee recruitment, onboarding, deployment and performance management of program personnel and partner teams. · Ensure that regional and facility implementation experience is incorporated rapidly into product and policy decisions. · Manage operational readiness for assessments, workshops, releases, field deployments, training, supervision and evaluation activities. · Ensure complete and timely technical, operational and financial reporting, supported by verifiable evidence. · Coordinate procurement, subaward administration, logistics, safety and project-specific compliance requirements. · Lead continuity planning and maintain effective operations during leadership absences or periods of rapid scale-up. Expected results · One integrated delivery plan connecting technical releases, field readiness, governance decisions and evaluation milestones. · Predictable delivery with early identification and resolution of cross-workstream dependencies. · Accurate management information and timely corrective actions. · Well-functioning teams and partners with clear roles, standards and performance expectations.
