Opian is an Ethiopian health-technology and innovation company building decision infrastructure for stronger health systems. We combine deep knowledge of how care and supply chains operate, human-centred product design, data engineering and responsible artificial intelligence. Our work helps health workers, managers and public institutions turn fragmented data into timely decisions—so essential medicines, vaccines and services are available where and when people need them.

Our philosophy

We believe useful innovation is not novelty for its own sake. It is the disciplined work of understanding a real problem, challenging assumptions, building and testing a better response, measuring what changes, and strengthening the institutions that must sustain the result. Technology is valuable only when it improves a decision, a workflow or an outcome in the real operating environment.

· Start with reality: design around the health workers, workloads, incentives, infrastructure and constraints that actually exist—not an imported ideal workflow.

· Build with people, not for them: government counterparts and frontline users are co-designers, decision-makers and eventual owners, not passive recipients.

· Strengthen the system, not a standalone application: connect workflows, data, institutions and incentives so information can lead to action across every level.

· Push boundaries responsibly: make ambitious but testable bets, protect safety and privacy, and change direction quickly when evidence contradicts the original idea.

· Make capability local and durable: transfer knowledge, product ownership and operational responsibility so progress continues without permanent dependence on an external project team.

· Be honest about impact: distinguish deployment from adoption and activity from results; make claims specific, measurable and open to verification.

What this means for candidates

Opian is looking for accomplished specialists who are also builders. Candidates should bring exceptional depth in their discipline, intellectual courage, practical judgment and the humility to learn from users and evidence. We value people who can move from ambiguity to a testable approach, from a workshop to an operating routine, and from a promising pilot to an institutionally owned system. The standard is simple: show not only what you know, but what you personally built, changed, tested, learned and left stronger.

· Work across public health, supply chain, policy, product, technology and field implementation boundaries.

· Turn expertise into usable products, processes, decisions and measurable improvements—not reports alone.

· Operate with urgency while preserving quality, public trust, data protection, service continuity and government ownership.


Role purpose

Translate the program strategy into disciplined day-to-day execution. The Deputy Project Director will run the integrated delivery system, coordinate technical and field teams, manage dependencies, maintain delivery standards and act for the Project Director when delegated.

Key responsibilities

· Maintain the integrated master workplan, milestone schedule, dependency map, decision log, risk register and action tracker.

· Coordinate product, supply-chain, interoperability, implementation, government-partnership, finance and evaluation teams around a single delivery cadence.

· Chair weekly delivery reviews and ensure that unresolved constraints are escalated with clear options and accountable owners.

· Oversee recruitment, onboarding, deployment and performance management of program personnel and partner teams.

· Ensure that regional and facility implementation experience is incorporated rapidly into product and policy decisions.

· Manage operational readiness for assessments, workshops, releases, field deployments, training, supervision and evaluation activities.

· Ensure complete and timely technical, operational and financial reporting, supported by verifiable evidence.

· Coordinate procurement, subaward administration, logistics, safety and project-specific compliance requirements.

· Lead continuity planning and maintain effective operations during leadership absences or periods of rapid scale-up.

Expected results

· One integrated delivery plan connecting technical releases, field readiness, governance decisions and evaluation milestones.

· Predictable delivery with early identification and resolution of cross-workstream dependencies.

· Accurate management information and timely corrective actions.

· Well-functioning teams and partners with clear roles, standards and performance expectations.

At Habesha Breweries, we're not just brewing beer – we're crafting experiences. Our Habesha Beer is celebrated for its golden hue, rich aroma, and remarkably smooth finish. It's the perfect lager for those who crave a beer with true character and identity. Every drop of our beer is made with Ethiopia’s finest water, sourced straight from the pristine highland grounds of Debre Birhan. Here, our dedicated and passionate team turns prime quality yeast, barley malt, and hops into the beloved Habesha Beer that stands as a testament to our commitment to excellence.

raw_payload.title: National Implementation and Change Management Lead
raw_payload.description:
About Opian

Opian is an Ethiopian health-technology and innovation company building decision infrastructure for stronger health systems. We combine deep knowledge of how care and supply chains operate, human-centred product design, data engineering and responsible artificial intelligence. Our work helps health workers, managers and public institutions turn fragmented data into timely decisions—so essential medicines, vaccines and services are available where and when people need them.

Our philosophy

We believe useful innovation is not novelty for its own sake. It is the disciplined work of understanding a real problem, challenging assumptions, building and testing a better response, measuring what changes, and strengthening the institutions that must sustain the result. Technology is valuable only when it improves a decision, a workflow or an outcome in the real operating environment.

· Start with reality: design around the health workers, workloads, incentives, infrastructure and constraints that actually exist—not an imported ideal workflow.

· Build with people, not for them: government counterparts and frontline users are co-designers, decision-makers and eventual owners, not passive recipients.

· Strengthen the system, not a standalone application: connect workflows, data, institutions and incentives so information can lead to action across every level.

· Push boundaries responsibly: make ambitious but testable bets, protect safety and privacy, and change direction quickly when evidence contradicts the original idea.

· Make capability local and durable: transfer knowledge, product ownership and operational responsibility so progress continues without permanent dependence on an external project team.

· Be honest about impact: distinguish deployment from adoption and activity from results; make claims specific, measurable and open to verification.

What this means for candidates

Opian is looking for accomplished specialists who are also builders. Candidates should bring exceptional depth in their discipline, intellectual courage, practical judgment and the humility to learn from users and evidence. We value people who can move from ambiguity to a testable approach, from a workshop to an operating routine, and from a promising pilot to an institutionally owned system. The standard is simple: show not only what you know, but what you personally built, changed, tested, learned and left stronger.

· Work across public health, supply chain, policy, product, technology and field implementation boundaries.

· Turn expertise into usable products, processes, decisions and measurable improvements—not reports alone.

· Operate with urgency while preserving quality, public trust, data protection, service continuity and government ownership.

Role purpose

Own the future-state technical architecture and ensure that ForLab+ and related components integrate securely and sustainably with Ethiopia’s national digital-health ecosystem, authoritative registries and existing transactional systems.

Key responsibilities

· Assess current applications, infrastructure, registries, standards, data flows, interfaces, ownership and technical debt relevant to the supply chain.

· Define the target architecture, integration patterns, data contracts, security model, deployment model and phased transition roadmap.

· Ensure authoritative use of the Master Facility Registry, National Product Catalog and other approved registries without creation of competing internal sources of truth.

· Design interoperability with logistics, warehouse, enterprise-resource, cold-chain, service-delivery and health-information systems as prioritized.

· Set engineering standards for APIs, messaging, identity and access, auditability, offline synchronization, observability, testing and documentation.

· Lead architecture reviews, technical risk decisions, integration testing, performance testing, security assurance and release readiness.

· Ensure traceable transformation from source transactions to integrated datasets, alerts and downstream analytics.

· Design for intermittent connectivity, realistic support capacity, open standards, maintainability and reasonable recurrent costs.

· Develop technical documentation, source-code and configuration custody arrangements, administrator training and government handover plans.

Expected results

· A stakeholder-approved current-state assessment and future-state architecture.

· Secure, documented and tested integrations with prioritized national systems and registries.

· A production-ready platform with observable performance, auditable data flows and reliable offline operation where required.

· Government technical teams able to administer, support and evolve the deployed solution.

company.description:
About the company

Teklehaimanot General Hospital is a patient-centered private hospital in the center of Addis Ababa that provides trusted multi-disciplinary medical services. With a focus on quality and customer care, it has a distinctive, compassionate, and honest approach to serving the need of all patients. Devised with experienced and compassionate medical staff, TGH is a health coach and medical partner to cater to all medical care needs. “An earnest deed is worth more than silver and gold” so fairness in price, quality, and flexibility creates a shelter for hope and recovery.
Through decades of unwavering endeavor to be a patient-centered private hospital, TGH is proud to offer over 70 General, specialty, subspecialty, and supportive services with 402 dedicated staff, of which 329 are full-time employees and 73 are part-time and contractual employees equipped with a culture of medical teamwork. Its credit program serves over 100 companies, Local and international companies, sharing in the grandeur of full hospitality that builds lasting patient-to-care provider relationships. For seven consecutive years, TGH has been ranked “Green Level” general hospital.

Our Mission

  • To be among the premium and most preferred healthcare providers in East Africa

Our Vision

  • To provide quality health care services at a reasonable price 

Our Values

“To nurture all human beings principled in honesty through compassion with the utmost respect”
TGH, with a strong commitment to nurturing all human beings, upholds the principles of honesty, compassion, and utmost respect. Through its unwavering dedication to providing exceptional healthcare services, The Hospital strives to become a trusted institution, a place where patients find solace, comfort, and the promise of a brighter future.
At Teklehaimanot General Hospital the core value of “nurturing all human beings’’ resonates throughout every aspect of the organization. From the moment patients step through the doors, they are greeted with warmth and empathy. The hospital's dedicated team of healthcare and Customer service professionals understands the critical importance of treating patients not just as medical cases, but as individuals deserving of kindness, compassion, and personalized attention. Every patient is regarded as a unique story, and the hospital's mission is to provide holistic care that addresses both physical and emotional well-being.
“Honesty” is the bedrock upon which Teklehaimanot General Hospital stands. Transparent communication, ethical practices, and integrity are the guiding principles that shape every interaction within the hospital. Patients and their families can trust that they will receive accurate information about their conditions, treatment options, and the overall care process. The hospital's commitment to honesty ensures that patients are empowered to make informed decisions and actively participate in their healthcare journey.
“Compassion” is the lifeblood that flows through the veins of Teklehaimanot General Hospital. The hospital's healthcare professionals are not only highly skilled and knowledgeable but also deeply empathetic and understanding. They recognize that patients may be experiencing fear, pain, or uncertainty and go above and beyond to provide comfort and support. Whether it's holding a hand, offering a listening ear, or providing words of encouragement, the hospital's staff is devoted to fostering an environment that promotes healing and emotional well-being.
Above all, Teklehaimanot General Hospital treats every individual with “utmost respect”. Regardless of age, gender, socioeconomic status, or background, every patient is valued and treated with dignity. The hospital's commitment to respect extends to its commitment to cultural sensitivity and inclusivity. The diverse needs and beliefs of patients are honored, and efforts are made to create an environment that is welcoming and accommodating to all.

Why work for us

fields.title: Packer Machine Operator
fields.description: Position Title: Packer Machine Operator Job Purpose To operate, monitor, and control the packer machine safely and efficiently to ensure the proper packing of finished beverage products according to production plans, quality standards, and packaging specifications. The position is responsible for machine setup, adjustment, basic troubleshooting, routine inspection, cleaning, and maintaining smooth and efficient packaging operations. Key Duties and Responsibilities Operate and monitor the packer machine in accordance with approved operating procedures and production schedules. Set up, adjust, and operate the packing equipment according to product type, packaging format, and production requirements. Ensure proper feeding, grouping, packing, and discharge of finished beverage products. Monitor the quality and integrity of packed products, packaging materials, cartons, trays, shrink film, and other packing materials as applicable. Ensure proper arrangement, alignment, counting, and packing of bottles/cans according to the specified packaging configuration. Conduct routine inspections of the packer machine and identify abnormal operating conditions, mechanical problems, product jams, and other malfunctions. Perform basic machine adjustments and troubleshooting to minimize downtime and maintain continuous production. Monitor machine operating parameters and ensure that the machine operates within established specifications. Ensure proper synchronization of the packer machine with conveyors, filler, labeller, shrink-wrapper, palletizer, and other associated packaging equipment as applicable. Check the availability and proper supply of packaging materials required for continuous operation. Identify and remove damaged, improperly packed, misaligned, or non-conforming products from the production line. Maintain accurate records of production output, machine stoppages, downtime, rejects, wastage, and packaging material consumption. Report machine breakdowns, quality deviations, material shortages, safety hazards, and abnormal operating conditions promptly to the supervisor or maintenance team. Work closely with maintenance personnel during preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, machine inspection, and breakdown recovery. Carry out routine cleaning, sanitation, lubrication, and operator-level maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S standards around the machine and packaging area. Ensure compliance with GMP, food safety, quality, occupational health and safety, environmental, and company requirements. Monitor and minimize product damage, packaging material wastage, and production losses. Follow approved procedures for machine start-up, operation, changeover, shutdown, and emergency stopping. Ensure that machine guards, interlocks, emergency stops, and other safety devices are properly installed and functional. Immediately stop the machine and report unsafe conditions that may cause injury, equipment damage, product contamination, or significant product loss. Participate in machine changeovers and adjustments according to the production plan. Monitor packaging quality to ensure that finished products meet established company standards and customer requirements. Participate in continuous improvement activities aimed at reducing downtime, waste, defects, and packaging costs. Follow all work instructions, standard operating procedures, GMP, HACCP/food safety, and other applicable management-system requirements. Perform other related duties assigned by the immediate supervisor.

fields.description: Job Summary The Finance Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and control of all financial resources, accounting operations, and treasury management for Ethio-BioPharma Enterprise. The Manager ensures that the enterprise’s financial activities are conducted in strict compliance with the Public Enterprises Proclamation, Ethiopian Tax Laws, and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). The role focuses on maintaining financial integrity, optimizing liquidity, ensuring accurate budgetary control, and providing timely financial advice to the CEO and the Board to support sustainable growth and operational efficiency A. Strategic Financial Management and Policy 1. Initiates and designs improvements to the enterprise’s financial policies, manuals, and internal control systems to safeguard assets. 2. Ensures the enterprise’s transition and continuous adherence to IFRS for all financial reporting. 3. Formulates long-term financial strategies and investment plans in line with the enterprise’s expansion goals. B. Budgeting and Performance Control Leads the preparation of the annual consolidated budget and monitors departmental spending 1. Analyzes financial variances and provides strategic recommendations to management to address budget overruns or revenue shortfalls. 2. Coordinates with the Ethiopian investment holdings (EIH) regarding financial performance targets and dividends. C. Financial Reporting and Auditing 1. Oversees the preparation of accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. 2. Serves as the primary liaison for the Office of the Federal Auditor General (OFAG) or external auditors to ensure smooth annual audit processes. 3. Ensures that all audit findings and management letters are addressed and corrective measures are implemented promptly. D. Treasury, Cash, and Tax Management 1. Manages the enterprise's liquidity to ensure sufficient funds for operations, projects, and debt servicing. 2. Maintains strong relationships with the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) and other financial institutions. 3. Ensures timely and accurate declaration and payment of all taxes (VAT, Withholding Tax, Business Income Tax, and Employee Income Tax) as per Ethiopian Ministry of Revenues regulations. E. Internal Controls and Risk Management 1. Establishes and maintains a robust internal control environment to prevent fraud, waste, and financial mismanagement. 2. Supervises the payroll process to ensure accuracy, compliance with pension regulations, and timely disbursement. 3. Conducts financial risk assessments related to currency fluctuations (especially for imported pharmaceutical inputs) and market trends. raw_payload.title: Finance Manager
raw_payload.description:
Job Summary

The Finance Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and control of all financial resources, accounting operations, and treasury management for Ethio-BioPharma Enterprise.

The Manager ensures that the enterprise’s financial activities are conducted in strict compliance with the Public Enterprises Proclamation, Ethiopian Tax Laws, and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). The role focuses on maintaining financial integrity, optimizing liquidity, ensuring accurate budgetary control, and providing timely financial advice to the CEO and the Board to support sustainable growth and operational efficiency

A. Strategic Financial Management and Policy

1. Initiates and designs improvements to the enterprise’s financial policies, manuals, and internal control systems to safeguard assets.

2. Ensures the enterprise’s transition and continuous adherence to IFRS for all financial reporting.

3. Formulates long-term financial strategies and investment plans in line with the enterprise’s expansion goals.

B.     Budgeting and Performance Control

Leads the preparation of the annual consolidated budget and monitors departmental spending

1. Analyzes financial variances and provides strategic recommendations to management to address budget overruns or revenue shortfalls.

2. Coordinates with the Ethiopian investment holdings (EIH) regarding financial performance targets and dividends.

C.     Financial Reporting and Auditing

1.  Oversees the preparation of accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

2.  Serves as the primary liaison for the Office of the Federal Auditor General (OFAG) or external auditors to ensure smooth annual audit processes.

3.  Ensures that all audit findings and management letters are addressed and corrective measures are implemented promptly.

D.      Treasury, Cash, and Tax Management

1.  Manages the enterprise's liquidity to ensure sufficient funds for operations, projects, and debt servicing.

2.  Maintains strong relationships with the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) and other financial institutions.

3.  Ensures timely and accurate declaration and payment of all taxes (VAT, Withholding Tax, Business Income Tax, and Employee Income Tax) as per Ethiopian Ministry of Revenues regulations.

E.     Internal Controls and Risk Management

1. Establishes and maintains a robust internal control environment to prevent fraud, waste, and financial mismanagement.

2. Supervises the payroll process to ensure accuracy, compliance with pension regulations, and timely disbursement.

3. Conducts financial risk assessments related to currency fluctuations (especially for imported pharmaceutical inputs) and market trends.

The Finance Manager is expected to carry out other related tasks as assigned by pertinent authority

Reports to: This positions reports to the CEO

Salary: As per the Organization's Scale

Job Summary GENERAL POSITION DESCRIPTION Main Purpose of the post The Finance Officer is responsible for the day-to-day execution of financial transactions, maintenance of accurate accounting records, and ensuring timely financial reporting. The Officer ensures that all payments, receipts, and ledger entries are performed in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), the enterprise’s financial manual, and Ethiopian tax regulations. The role focuses on operational accuracy, document verification, tax compliance, and supporting the Finance Manager in preparing financial statements and audit schedules. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / ACCOUNTABILITY Transaction Processing and Documentation Prepares and verifies payment vouchers (PVs), cash receipt vouchers (CRVs), and journal entries with proper supporting documentation. Tax Compliance and Statutory Remittances Calculates and prepares monthly tax declarations, including VAT, Withholding Tax, and Employment Income Tax (POYE). Prepares and reconciles pension contribution reports and ensures timely remittance to the relevant government pension agency. Bank and Account Reconciliation Performs monthly bank reconciliations for all enterprise accounts and investigates any discrepancies immediately. Monitors and reconciles accounts receivable (debtors) and accounts payable (creditors) to ensure the enterprise's aging report is accurate. Reconciles inter-departmental accounts and project-specific funds. Payroll and Petty Cash Management Assists in the preparation of the monthly payroll, ensuring accurate deductions (advances, taxes, pensions, and court orders). Manages and replenishes the petty cash fund in accordance with the enterprise's cash handling policy and ensures all small expenditures are properly authorized. Conducts periodic cash counts and ensures the security of cash on hand. Audit and Reporting Support Assists the Finance Manager in preparing schedules and work papers for quarterly and annual financial reports. Provides required documentation and explanations to internal and external auditors (OFAG) during the audit process. Monitors budget utilization at the unit level and alerts the Manager of potential over-expenditures. The Finance Officer is expected to carry out other related tasks as assigned by pertinent authorit Authority The Finance Officer is authorized to: Verify the accuracy and validity of invoices and payment requests before processing. Reject payment requests that lack sufficient supporting documentation or proper authorization. Initiate bank transfers and cheque preparation for authorized signatures. Communicate with vendors and banks regarding transaction status and reconciliation issues. Effort required The position requires high levels of numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and integrity. Since the year 2000, Ipas Ethiopia has been collaborating with the Ministry of Health (MOH), Regional Health Bureaus (RHBs), Community Based Organizations (CBOs) and various local and international partners to reduce maternal mortality and morbidity resulting from unwanted pregnancy and unsafe abortion. In light of the need to strengthen our relationship with stakeholders and expedite programme implementation, we are planning to hire for the following position: Job Title : Research, Monitoring and Evaluation (RM&E) Advisor Place of Work: Addis Ababa Report to: Senior Research and Evaluation (R&E) Advisor Position Type: Full-time Grade : S1 Terms of Employment: One year with possibilities for extension Salary : Negotiable General Description The Research, Monitoring & Evaluation (RM&E) Advisor is responsible for providing technical support for Ipas Ethiopia’s research, monitoring and evaluation efforts and collaborating with the technical and program units to ensure high-quality Research, Monitoring, and Evaluation (RM&E) processes and methodologies. The RM&E Advisor will ensure that data are shared to and used by internal and external audiences through routine review of findings and dissemination in conferences and publications. Job summary:

The IT Technical Team Leader is responsible for leading, coordinating, and supervising the technical team in the design, implementation, configuration, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, and support of IT infrastructure and technology solutions. The position ensures that technical projects and customer requirements are delivered on time, within scope, and according to required quality and technical standards

Responsibilities:

  • ·Lead, coordinate, and supervise the IT technical team and daily technical activities.
  • Assign technical tasks and monitor team members' performance and progress.
  • Design, implement, configure, and maintain IT infrastructure solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for network, server, cybersecurity, data center, CCTV, systems, and related IT projects.
  • Review technical requirements, specifications, BoQs, and project designs.
  • Participate in site surveys, technical assessments, and solution design.
  • Support the Presales team with technical proposals, solution design, BoQ preparation, and technical documentation.
  • Plan and coordinate installation, configuration, testing, commissioning, and handover of IT projects.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide timely solutions.
  • Ensure proper documentation of configurations, network diagrams, installation reports, test results, and handover documents.
  • Coordinate with customers, suppliers, vendors, consultants, and internal departments.
  • Monitor project schedules, deliverables, resources, and technical quality.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, project specifications, and industry standards.
  • Conduct system testing and quality assurance before project handover.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
  • Monitor the performance, availability, and reliability of deployed systems.
  • Ensure proper use, maintenance, and security of company technical tools and equipment.
  • Prepare technical progress reports and provide regular updates to management.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and technical training for team members.
  • Keep up to date with emerging IT technologies, products, and industry practices.
  • Perform other technical duties assigned by management.
  • Willing to travel and able to work in field projects.

fields.description: Purpose of the Job: To achieve sustainable growth and profitability of the Bank through cross selling the Bank’s products and services, acquiring & retaining customers, improving customer services and building strong customer relationships to maximize resources mobilization efforts, managing overall retail banking operations at the assigned branch. Generic Functions: · Prepare /review work plans/budgets of the branch and monitor its execution · Embody the bank’s good culture & corporate image · Demonstrate the Bank’s code of conduct, ascertain that subordinates abide by same and manage disciplinary concerns · Provide services as per the service level agreement, follow- up and monitor subordinates to do the same · Contribute to the bank’s profitability as per the target set · Mentor and coach subordinates towards effective career development Specific Functions: · Plan and lead the enhancement of the resource mobilization activity of the branch by organizing and effectively coordinating the branch workforce · Check whether the Branch’s books of accounts are in balance, review Income & Expense Summary Accounts of the Branch & apply strict follow-up on controllable expenses · Ensure that transactions are authorized immediately and end-of-business cycle processes are done on a timely basis

company.name: Amhara Bank S.C.
company.description:
The bank was established with the largest initial shareholder base in the history of Ethiopia's private banking sector, comprising over 167,000 shareholders. The bank's paid-up capital has reached more than 7.4 billion ETB. As of recent financial reporting, its total capital reserves exceed 10.285 billion Birr.


Operations and Services

Amhara Bank operates a network of over 322 branches across Ethiopia, serving a customer base of approximately 2.9 million individuals.


Digital Banking

The bank provides digital financial services, primarily through a proprietary mobile banking application. The digital platform has registered over 1.2 million subscribers.


Interest-Free Banking

Amhara Bank operates a full-fledged interest-free banking (IFB) window under the brand name "Marhaba," which was launched on March 18, 2023. The service offers Sharia-compliant financial products tailored for customers seeking non-interest financial solutions.

raw_payload.title: Branch Manager Grade-I
raw_payload.description:
Purpose of the Job: To achieve sustainable growth and profitability of the Bank through cross selling the Bank’s products and services, acquiring & retaining customers, improving customer services and building strong customer relationships to maximize resources mobilization efforts, managing overall retail banking operations at the assigned branch.

Generic Functions:

·       Prepare /review work plans/budgets of the branch and monitor its execution

·       Embody the bank’s good culture & corporate image

·       Demonstrate the Bank’s code of conduct, ascertain that subordinates abide by same and manage disciplinary concerns

·       Provide services as per the service level agreement, follow- up and monitor subordinates to do the same

·       Contribute to the bank’s profitability as per the target set

·       Mentor and coach subordinates towards effective career development

Specific Functions:

·       Plan and lead the enhancement of the resource mobilization activity of the branch by organizing and effectively coordinating the branch workforce

·       Check whether the Branch’s books of accounts are in balance, review Income & Expense Summary Accounts of the Branch & apply strict follow-up on controllable expenses

·       Ensure that transactions are authorized immediately and end-of-business cycle processes are done on a timely basis
